description: One row = one dataset (authoritative). Evidence for values is in evidence.csv
One row = evidence for one value in datasets (source, date checked, type)
Other names of datasets (official names, other names, former labels, etc.)
Relations between datasets (versions, different datasets, suspected identity, etc.)

Annotations of a dataset: its label sets (emotion_categories, emotion_attributes, speaking_style, ...) and other annotations (transcripts, speaker traits, ratings, ...). One row = dataset x item x name. Each row carries its own source
One row = one source document (paper, page, card, license file, release files, recipe readme). Evidence, annotations, aliases and relations point to it by source_id
The sources that introduce a dataset: its paper, its distribution page, its card, mirrors, its recipe readme
Number of files per label of a label set, as stated by a source (the documentation or the recipe readme)
Spelling variants of label names that map to one normalised name (case, word form, translations the source gives). No meaning-changing mappings
